lightRegime.text: constant fluorescent light; one 12 h dark pulse immediately before 12 h of constant light at collection; no diel cycling

medium.text: BG-11 agar plates, no ZnCl₂ added

caveat: Measured in PCC 7942 on BG-11 agar plates, not in liquid culture and not in UTEX 2973; wild type without ZnCl₂ only, the labA knock-out and the zinc-induced kaiA strains are not shipped.
